title: Belrose Circle Membership Programme Tier Qualification Schedule
content:
# Belrose Circle Membership Programme — Tier Qualification Schedule

The Belrose Circle Membership Programme runs on six tiers, ranked from Belrose Circle Member at the bottom to the Belrose Circle Founders' Club at the top. The schedule below fixes, for each tier, the qualifying spend in a membership year that brings a member into the tier, the qualifying spend in a membership year that keeps a member at the tier, the qualifying spend that brings a lapsed membership at that tier back to life, the whole months between tier reviews, the whole months a member keeps a tier they no longer qualify for, and whether an upgrade into the tier takes effect at once rather than at the next review. All spend figures are in USD.

## Schedule

| Rank | Tier | Entry qualifying spend (membership year) | Maintenance qualifying spend (membership year) | Requalification spend (lapsed membership) | Review interval (whole months) | Downgrade grace (whole months) | Upgrade takes effect at once |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Belrose Circle Member | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | 12 | 0 | No |
| 2 | Belrose Circle Silver | USD 2500.00 | USD 1500.00 | USD 500.00 | 12 | 3 | No |
| 3 | Belrose Circle Gold | USD 7500.00 | USD 5000.00 | USD 1000.00 | 12 | 3 | Yes |
| 4 | Belrose Circle Platinum | USD 20000.00 | USD 15000.00 | USD 2500.00 | 12 | 6 | Yes |
| 5 | Belrose Circle Black | USD 60000.00 | USD 45000.00 | USD 7500.00 | 12 | 6 | Yes |
| 6 | Belrose Circle Founders' Club | USD 200000.00 | USD 150000.00 | USD 25000.00 | 24 | 12 | Yes |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The entry gate of each tier is the minimum annual qualifying spend shown in the entry column: USD 0.00 for Belrose Circle Member, USD 2500.00 for Belrose Circle Silver, USD 7500.00 for Belrose Circle Gold, USD 20000.00 for Belrose Circle Platinum, USD 60000.00 for Belrose Circle Black and USD 200000.00 for the Belrose Circle Founders' Club. The Belrose Circle Founders' Club is in addition entered by invitation only, and its annual fee is payable as a condition of entry.
2. The maintenance column is the figure a tier is kept at. At every tier above Belrose Circle Member the maintenance spend is lower than the entry spend, so a member who entered Belrose Circle Gold on USD 7500.00 of qualifying spend keeps it on USD 5000.00 in the following membership year.
3. The requalification column is the qualifying spend that brings a lapsed membership at that tier back to life; for Belrose Circle Member it is USD 0.00.
4. The review interval is 12 whole months at every tier except the Belrose Circle Founders' Club, where it is 24 whole months.
5. The downgrade grace is the number of whole months a member keeps a tier whose maintenance spend they no longer meet: none at Belrose Circle Member, 3 at Belrose Circle Silver and Belrose Circle Gold, 6 at Belrose Circle Platinum and Belrose Circle Black, and 12 at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club.
6. An upgrade takes effect at once at Belrose Circle Gold, Belrose Circle Platinum, Belrose Circle Black and the Belrose Circle Founders' Club; at Belrose Circle Member and Belrose Circle Silver it takes effect at the next review.

## Reading the entry gate (hypothetical figures)

The entry figure is a minimum. A membership year in which USD 7500.00 of qualifying spend is recorded reaches the Belrose Circle Gold entry gate exactly; a year in which USD 7499.99 is recorded falls short of it. A year with USD 60000.00 recorded reaches the Belrose Circle Black entry gate; USD 59999.99 does not.
